messages:
Maya Chen: quick ping — opened a small PR for docs + SDK example cleanups, would love a quick 👀 when you have a minute. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

PR notes: cleaned up Python quickstart (auth snippet), fixed a typo in JS example, and clarified the env var section. Only 3 changed files, ~45 lines. No behavior changes to SDKs, just docs + snippets.

Ryan Patel: on it, will skim now. If it's just wording + snippets I can approve quickly.

Luis Gomez: tagging @Emily K for the JS snippet check — I can review Python bits later today.

Emily K: saw the JS example — one small suggestion on the fetch headers (need Authorization: `Bearer <token>`, not `Token`). I'll leave an inline comment. otherwise looks fine.

Maya Chen: thanks! the change is exactly that — I swapped Token->Bearer in two places. left one nit about path param wording if you want to spot-check @Ryan.

Ryan Patel: skimmed the diff, left one suggestion about using the SDK client example (instead of raw fetch) in an extra note. not blocking.

Luis Gomez: reviewed Python quickstart: replaced sample with correct auth header and added example for async client usage. left a minor formatting nit in the code block (trailing space).

Maya Chen: all good — pushed a tiny follow-up fixing Emily's and Luis' nits. PTAL when you have sec. I plan to merge after one final approval so we can ship the updated quickstart docs with today's release.

Emily K: approved — looks good now. :thumbsup:

Ryan Patel: approved.

docs-bot: PR merged by Maya Chen into main (commit 9f4b2d). Deploy pipeline scheduled for 12:30 UTC.

Maya Chen: thanks team! if anything breaks ping me here and I'll revert.
